fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 is not an executable finite family. Enumerating m=3 chirps does not specify the incidence-dependent symplectic transformations, shared-block assembly, allowed weights, or one-/two-copy Gram and target; nonorthogonality alone gives no reason the G32/G37 parity acquires positive superadditive energy.

Proposal 2 is defeated by G13 for any linear toric gluing that accepts every honest encoding. The fixed integral affine combination of honest global encodings induces bag selectors satisfying every such map with the same O(1) coefficients, so determinant or Smith-invariant growth cannot enlarge that zero-residual witness.

Proposal 3 supplies no relative gap mechanism. If its linear algebraic defects vanish on all honest encodings, G13 affine combinations also annihilate them; if honest tags have nonzero trace energy, the field-degree factor generally scales the completeness radius as well. The tag assignment, coupling, center, and finite enumeration domain are also unspecified.

Proposal 4 is the only mechanism not already structurally disposed of, but its proposed experiment is not preregistered: the regular graph, compiler, holonomy labels, emitted equations, objective, and numerical growth threshold are absent. Values for L=1,2,3,4 cannot discriminate exponential propagation without a fixed recurrence inequality and matched-control accounting.

Proposal 5 confuses torsion order with Euclidean systole. Smith invariant T alone permits short presentations and short Bezout representatives, while testing unspecified small matrices only at T=5,7 cannot distinguish an asymptotic systolic family; no explicit chain-complex family or metric lower bound is given.

Proposal 6 is ill-defined literally: for a single vector v, every exterior power v wedge v and hence wedge^j v for j>=2 is zero. Reinterpreting it as compound coordinates of a frame or squarefree monomials is a different mutation requiring an explicit frame map, incidence coupling, dimension bound, Gram, and common-sphere system.

Generation 32 verified two compatible parity blocks of cost 432=2d1^2 despite all degree-at-most-three cross-copy moment rows. Generation 37 symbolically verified W2=2W1 throughout its frozen orthogonal metric family.

Generation 31 is only a fixed-instance shell pass, while Generations 14 and 15 show respectively that dense bags may pass finitely and sparse linear hierarchies may still admit affine lifts. None supplies the missing composition or polynomial-gap theorem.

No verifier evidence, emitted factors, targets, exact centers, or finite search manifests are supplied for any of the six proposals. Their claimed expected moves therefore have no experimental support.
